purpose: Dispatcher that saves QuickBooks Online records for an entity: strips the "sparse" and "domain" keys from the record JSON, then routes by Entity name to that entity's "Field Map :: Set" script (22 entities, from CompanyInfo to Attachable). Invoice, SalesReceipt and Estimate keep only SalesItemLineDetail lines, and Invoice/Estimate also drop the shipping line.
